relation_checks.primary_support: Confirmed: terminal LNA guanylate replacement, altered RT conditions/order, and omission of first-strand cleanup with KAPA preamplification are explicitly reported. Tested commercial SMARTer comparisons must not be generalized to every historical variant.
relation_checks.gain_and_tradeoff: Qualitative gains and amplification-dependent expression-bias warning are supported. The existing caution against adding individual gains is appropriate.
relation_checks.anchor_result: Target op_switch/op_rt/op_pcr exist and are relevant. o_purify is downstream of PCR, so leaving it out of the removed-cleanup claim is correct. The TSO change lacks its relevant predecessor anchor o_second.
relation_checks.concentration_check: No current stock-versus-final error found: 6 mM MgCl2 is explicitly a final SMARTer-buffer concentration in Results p2. Online Methods p4 lists 100 mM MgCl2 and 5 M betaine as stocks alongside added volumes, not final reaction concentrations. Do not promote these stock values to method conditions or derive finals without a consistent scoped reaction volume.

relation_checks.primary_support: The later paper explicitly attributes its development to CEL-Seq and reports replacing aRNA-adaptor ligation with a tailed random primer during RT.
relation_checks.gain_and_tradeoff: 93.8% versus 60.9% is the stated same-aRNA mapping comparison. The three-prime/splicing qualification and warning about a UMI-modified comparison arm are supported.
relation_checks.anchor_result: The archived prep operation covers the affected library-conversion block. Leaving target operations empty is appropriate because no CEL-Seq2 workflow was extracted.
relation_checks.scope_check: Bead cleanup describes the manual optimization. C1 instead omits cDNA cleanup, heat-inactivates enzymes, performs IVT separately, and pools aRNA afterward. Early barcoding remains supported; current prose does not wrongly assert early pooling.

Qualify bead-cleanup optimization as the manual CEL-Seq2 workflow; preserve C1 as a distinct implementation if later expanded into a graph.
